Helps to find out what happens when the work stops or the app is ended. Nothing is sent anywhere - files stay on the phone.

Everything from the Log tab with exact times, plus: start and end of every task and file with its duration, errors, system events (screen, charger, battery saver, doze, overheating, memory warnings, the app being ended), engine processes with their exit reason, and every 10 minutes temperatures, CPU speeds, memory and power state. One file per day, copied every minute.
No automatic dumps. The \"Dump now\" button still works.
Like a Windows small memory dump: job state, settings, phone state, last log lines and all app threads. A few hundred kB.

Like a Windows kernel memory dump: small dump + Python threads, memory maps of the app and the engine, system memory pressure, all temperature sensors, why earlier app processes ended with Android\'s crash traces, and the work files. About 1 MB.

Like a Windows complete memory dump: extended dump + the whole Java heap (.hprof, opens in Android Studio). Tens to hundreds of MB. The engine\'s model memory is not dumped - it is the model file itself.
Like Windows automatic dump: extended for crashes, unexpected ends and manual dumps, small for errors and pauses.

turbo (2B): the default. Fast - 8 diffusion steps - with very high quality. File 1.45 GB (Q4_K_M) to 4.5 GB (BF16). Best for most phones and for trying ideas.
sft (2B): careful, follows the description and lyrics more closely, uses guidance. Needs about 50 steps (set Steps to 50), so roughly 6x slower than turbo. Same size as turbo.
base (2B): the most varied and creative results, quality a little lower than turbo/sft. About 50 steps, slow. Same size as turbo.

xl-turbo (4B): bigger model with richer sound, still only 8 steps. About twice the RAM and time of turbo. File 2.8 GB (Q4_K_M) to 9.3 GB (BF16). The best quality-to-time choice on a phone with enough RAM.
xl-sft (4B): the highest audio quality, clearest vocals and instruments. 50 steps on a 4B model - very slow on a phone (can take hours). For the final version of a favourite track.
xl-base (4B): the most versatile XL model with the most variety. 50 steps, very slow.
Q4_K_M: the smallest and least RAM, slight quality loss you may hear in details. Default for phones.
Q5_K_M: a good balance - noticeably better than Q4, still small.
Q6_K: very close to the original model.
Q8_0: practically identical to the original. Recommended when the RAM allows it.
BF16: the original precision, twice the size of Q8_0, usually slower on a phone and not audibly better than Q8_0.
No language model: the music model works directly from your description. Fastest, least RAM. Used only in Text mode anyway.
Language model 0.6B (~0.7 GB): plans the structure and details of a new track from the description. For phones with up to ~12 GB RAM. Text mode only.
Language model 1.7B (~1.9 GB): understands descriptions and lyrics better. For 12 GB RAM and more. Text mode only.
Language model 4B (~4.2 GB): the best understanding, but large - together with an XL model it rarely fits in a phone\'s RAM. Text mode only.

How to choose: try ideas with turbo or xl-turbo (Q6_K / Q8_0), make the final version with xl-sft and 50 steps. Every model also needs the text encoder (0.78 GB) and the audio decoder (0.34 GB). The Start dialog shows the exact download and RAM need.
